     5→import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory
     6→import org.springframework.stereotype.Component
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * DSearch 시스템 인덱스 초기화.
    10→ *
    11→ * 클러스터 등록 시 필요한 dsearch-* 인덱스가 없으면 자동 생성.
    12→ * ES 9.x에서는 점(.) 접두사 인덱스가 제한되므로 dsearch- 접두사 사용.
    13→ */
    14→@Component
    15→class SystemIndexInitializer(
    16→    private val factory: ElasticsearchClientFactory,
    17→) {
    18→    private val logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(SystemIndexInitializer::class.java)
    19→
    20→    companion object {
    21→        val SYSTEM_INDICES =
    22→            listOf(
    23→                "dsearch-index-history",
    24→                "dsearch-index-status",
    25→            )
    26→    }
    27→
    28→    fun initialize(clusterId: String) {
    29→        val client =
    30→            runCatching { factory.getClient(clusterId) }.getOrElse {
    31→                logger.warn("클러스터 {} 클라이언트를 가져올 수 없습니다. 시스템 인덱스 초기화 스킵.", clusterId)
    32→                return
    33→            }
    34→
    35→        SYSTEM_INDICES.forEach { indexName ->
    36→            ensureIndexExists(client, clusterId, indexName)
    37→        }
    38→    }
    39→
    40→    private fun ensureIndexExists(
    41→        client: ElasticsearchClient,
    42→        clusterId: String,
    43→        indexName: String,
    44→    ) {
    45→        runCatching {
    46→            val exists = client.indices().exists { it.index(indexName) }.value()
    47→            if (!exists) {
    48→                client.indices().create(
    49→                    CreateIndexRequest
    50→                        .Builder()
    51→                        .index(indexName)
    52→                        .build(),
    53→                )
    54→                logger.info("클러스터 {} 시스템 인덱스 생성: {}", clusterId, indexName)
    55→            }
    56→        }.onFailure { e ->
    57→            logger.warn("클러스터 {} 시스템 인덱스 {} 초기화 실패: {}", clusterId, indexName, e.message)
    58→        }
    59→    }

package com.cowave.search.config

import co.elastic.clients.elasticsearch.ElasticsearchClient
import co.elastic.clients.json.jackson.JacksonJsonpMapper
import co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.Rest5ClientTransport
import co.elastic.clients.transport.rest5_client.low_level.Rest5Client
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.SerializationFeature
import com.fasterxml.jackson.datatype.jsr310.JavaTimeModule
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.kotlinModule
import org.apache.hc.core5.http.Header
import org.apache.hc.core5.http.HttpHost
import org.apache.hc.core5.http.message.BasicHeader
import org.springframework.boot.context.properties.ConfigurationProperties
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean
import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration

@Configuration
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = "elasticsearch")
class ElasticsearchConfig {
    var url: String = ""
    var apiKey: String = ""

    @Bean
    fun esRestClient(): Rest5Client {
        val host = HttpHost.create(url.removeSuffix("/"))
        val headers =
            arrayOf<Header>(
                BasicHeader("Authorization", "ApiKey $apiKey"),
            )
        return Rest5Client
            .builder(host)
            .setDefaultHeaders(headers)
            .build()
    }

    @Bean
    fun esClient(restClient: Rest5Client): ElasticsearchClient {
        val objectMapper =
            ObjectMapper()
                .registerModule(kotlinModule())
                .registerModule(JavaTimeModule())
                .disable(SerializationFeature.WRITE_DATES_AS_TIMESTAMPS)

        val transport = Rest5ClientTransport(restClient, JacksonJsonpMapper(objectMapper))

        return ElasticsearchClient(transport)
    }
}

### 핵심 수정 사항

**ES Java API Client v9 API 형태 수정** (`/Users/admin/project/admin/search-admin/src/main/kotlin/com/cowave/search/collection/service/CollectionService.kt`):

| 잘못된 코드 | 올바른 코드 |
|---|---|
| `aliasMap.keys().firstOrNull()` | `aliasResponse.aliases().keys.firstOrNull()` |
| `aliases.result().keys` | `aliases.aliases().keys` |

**`updateAliases` 조건부 액션** — 조건에 따라 액션을 동적으로 추가해야 하는 경우, `buildList{}`로 먼저 목록을 구성한 후 `actions(List)` 오버로드로 한 번에 전달:

```kotlin
val actionList = buildList {
    if (oldIndex != null && oldIndex != newIndex) {
        add(Action.of { a -> a.remove { it.index(oldIndex).alias(baseId) } })
    }
    add(Action.of { a -> a.add { it.index(newIndex).alias(baseId) } })
}
client.indices().updateAliases { req -> req.actions(actionList) }
```
